name: fentanyl
notes: Longer context-sensitive half-time than remifentanil. Concentrations conventionally in ng/mL.

protein_binding.note: ~84% bound (albumin and α1-acid glycoprotein). Hypoalbuminemia / raised α1-AG in acute illness shift the free fraction; a given total concentration then maps to a different effect than a normal-binding model assumes. Surfaced as a documented failure mode (v0.5 §B3), not modeled.
